name: connection_test
description: Quick sanity check: confirms serial connectivity and that both discharge and charge commands actually drive the cell
comment: Run this first on a new setup, before any longer real test: 60s discharge at 0.5A, then 60s charge at 0.5A. Change 'cell' to whichever cell you actually have connected -- 0.5A is gentle enough to be safe on any cell in the library. Watch the LCD: it should show '-PC-', then an active discharge for 60s, then an active charge for 60s.
